clue.text: New York borough substitutes top judges

parts.note: Queens is one of the five boroughs of New York City
in team sport the substitutes sit on the bench, so the word can stand for them

explanation.surface: A New York district swaps out its leading judges.
explanation.walkthrough: QUEEN'S BENCH is a division of the English High Court, the senior trial court.
explanation.definitionFit: The bench of that High Court division is made up of senior judges, so the court name stands for its top judiciary.

clue.text: Coin made with craft having queen on both sides

indicators.note: having here means holding, so the craft word is kept between the queen letters
the queen abbreviations stand at either end, flanking the craft word

parts.note: queen gives two abbreviations here: QU at the front and ER (Elizabeth Regina) at the back
craft in the sense of skill or artistry

explanation.surface: A coin is minted showing a craft with the queen's head on each face.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'queen' does double duty, supplying a different abbreviation at each end.
explanation.definitionFit: A quarter is the American twenty-five-cent piece, a familiar coin.

clue.text: A sports car in Spain raised problem

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising the letters means reading them from the bottom upwards

parts.note: MG is a classic British sports car marque
taken as written
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A sports car in Spain is jacked up because something has gone wrong with it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns AMGINE (A, MG, IN, E) upside down in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: An enigma is a puzzle or mystery, something hard to work out, much like a problem.

clue.text: Entertainment venues suit going after drunken thing

indicators.note: the suit is placed after the jumbled word
drunken suggests something staggering out of order, so the letters of thing are jumbled

parts.note: clubs is one of the four suits in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: A description of a sloppy night out: venues where a suit follows something that has had too much.
explanation.definitionFit: Late-opening clubs with music and dancing are places offering entertainment after dark.

clue.text: Composer's Welsh address

definitions.meaning: the 's stands for 'is', linking the two senses
in Wales a term of endearment, like 'dear' or 'love', used when speaking to someone

explanation.surface: How a composer greets you, Welsh style.
explanation.definitionFit: Johann Sebastian is the great Baroque composer, and the same word is a Welsh endearment meaning little one or dear.

clue.text: Midland town with a lot on its plate by the sound of it

indicators.note: the town's name is heard as a phrase spoken aloud

parts.words: with a lot on its plate
parts.note: if a lot is still on the plate, then none has been consumed: 'none eaten'

explanation.surface: A busy English town with too much on its plate.
explanation.walkthrough: NUNEATON is a town in Warwickshire, in the English Midlands. 'A lot on its plate' usually means busy; here it is literal: the food left untouched, 'none eaten'.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a market town in north Warwickshire, a county of central England.

clue.text: Talk show hostess upset about threat to whales

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the hostess's name is read backwards

parts.note: Oprah Winfrey, the American talk show host
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: A talk show hostess is upset about the threat to whales.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'upset' means turned upside down, which reads the name from the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: A barbed spear fired at whales by hunters is the classic whaling weapon.

clue.text: On level terms, scent victory to be secured

indicators.note: the victory is held fast inside the scent word

parts.note: a drag is an artificial scent trail laid for hounds to follow
a win is a victory

explanation.surface: A hunt, level so far, catches the scent and has victory within reach.
explanation.walkthrough: A drag hunt follows a scent trail laid in advance rather than a live fox.
explanation.definitionFit: Teams drawing are tied, with neither side ahead in the scores.

clue.text: What Cockney bigamist has is incomprehensible

definitions.meaning: in Cockney slang 'my old Dutch' is a wife, so a man with two wives has a pair of them
speech that cannot be understood, gibberish

explanation.surface: A joke about a Londoner with two wives being impossible to follow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dutch' (from 'duchess') is Cockney slang for wife, as in the music-hall song 'My Old Dutch'.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for gibberish or language no one can follow.

clue.text: False rumours an eccentric's spreading around

indicators.note: the eccentric word spreads itself round the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a card is an eccentric or amusing character; read as a plural, cards

explanation.surface: Untrue gossip is being put about by an oddball.
explanation.definitionFit: A canard is an unfounded story or hoax deliberately circulated.

clue.text: Lincoln beat these East European cars

parts.note: a Slav is a person from one of the Slavic peoples of Eastern Europe
estates are estate cars, what Americans call station wagons

explanation.surface: Abraham Lincoln outdoes some cars from Eastern Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lincoln' looks like a car make beside 'cars', but it is the president who won the Civil War.
explanation.definitionFit: The Confederacy's slaveholding southern states were defeated in the American Civil War under President Lincoln.

clue.text: Most important officer in uniform I beat at chess

parts.note: U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant
to mate an opponent is to checkmate them

explanation.surface: An officer in uniform boasts of beating someone at chess.
explanation.definitionFit: Ultimate here means fundamental or supreme, the greatest in importance.

clue.text: Assistant welcoming a deity in temple

indicators.note: the assistant takes in the other pieces, holding them inside

parts.note: PA is a personal assistant
a god is a deity

explanation.surface: An assistant greets a god at a temple.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiered tower used as a Buddhist or Hindu shrine in East Asia.

clue.text: One on street beset by drink, driven mad

indicators.note: the first pieces are surrounded on all sides by the drink word

parts.note: a draught is a drink or swallow
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone out on the street, overwhelmed by drink, goes out of their mind.
explanation.definitionFit: Distraught means extremely upset, almost out of one's wits.

clue.text: Dido? Singer producing high notes

definitions.meaning: a dido is a prank or mischievous caper; the query admits the name is a red herring for the singer
a songbird famous for singing as it rises high in the air

explanation.surface: Is Dido a singer who hits the high notes?
explanation.walkthrough: Dido looks like the pop singer or the queen of Carthage; as a lower-case word it means a prank.
explanation.definitionFit: A lark is both a bit of fun or a caper and a skylark, a bird known for soaring song.

clue.text: I found clue confused a small amount

indicators.note: confused letters are mixed up, so the phrase before it is rearranged

explanation.surface: A solver admits a clue baffled them a little.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a unit of liquid volume, about 28 millilitres in Britain, a small measure.

clue.text: Religious institutions needing sign after yesterday

indicators.note: the sign is placed after the day

parts.note: for a puzzle printed on a Saturday, yesterday was Friday, abbreviated Fri
Aries is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Religious bodies wanting a sign after what happened yesterday.
explanation.walkthrough: The puzzle appeared on a Saturday, so 'yesterday' is FRI.
explanation.definitionFit: Friaries are houses where friars live, monastic communities.

clue.text: Issue containing commemoration of late princess

parts.note: Di is Diana, Princess of Wales, who died in 1997; 'of' gives the possessive 's
a tribute is something said or done in honour of someone

explanation.surface: A magazine issue carries a memorial piece about Princess Diana.
explanation.walkthrough: 'containing' just says the answer holds the phrase Di's tribute.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue things is to hand them out, to give or share them among people.

clue.text: One on the lookout for source of one-upmanship

definitions.meaning: someone who watches out, as for birds, trains or enemy aircraft
Stephen Potter, ..., wrote the humorous book 'One-Upmanship' that coined the word

explanation.surface: A watcher looking for a chance to get one over on others.
explanation.definitionFit: A spotter is an observer, and S. Potter is the author whose book named one-upmanship.

clue.text: Worry about breaking foot

indicators.note: the about word breaks into the foot abbreviation, splitting it

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Anxiety over a broken foot.
explanation.definitionFit: To fret is to be anxious or troubled, a synonym for worry.

clue.text: Again bring out freebies regularly provided by girl

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals, every second one of freebies

parts.note: Sue is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl keeps handing out free gifts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' picks R, E, I, S from fREeBiEs.
explanation.definitionFit: To reissue a book or record is to publish or release it a second time.

clue.text: Socialise with top-of-the-range plutocrat

parts.note: a hob is the cooking surface on top of a range or cooker
a nob is a wealthy, upper-class person

explanation.surface: Mix with a rich person who has the very best of everything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top-of-the-range' suggests luxury but means the hob on top of a cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: To hobnob is to mix socially, especially with people of higher status.

clue.text: God with weapon cut down chest

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder

indicators.note: the weapon word is shortened, losing its final letter

parts.note: an axe is a weapon

explanation.surface: A god with a weapon strikes someone down in the chest.
explanation.definitionFit: The thorax is the part of the body between the neck and abdomen.

clue.text: Standard lyricist who produces satire

definitions.note: a clause meaning one who mocks by imitation; read as a noun

parts.note: par is the standard or norm
an odist is a writer of odes, lyric poems

explanation.surface: A conventional songwriter who turns out satire.
explanation.definitionFit: A parodist imitates a work to mock it, a kind of satirist.

clue.text: Nothing more than a lake

definitions.meaning: the adjective meaning only or just
a lake or pond, common in English place names

explanation.surface: It's only a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means only or simply, and is also an old word for a small lake.

clue.text: Means to communicate urgently what's selling out

definitions.meaning: a direct phone link for emergencies, like the one between Washington and Moscow
a ... is a product line that sells fast

explanation.surface: A shop advertises an urgent contact for its best-selling goods.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both an emergency telephone link and a popular range of merchandise.

clue.text: Band is led by Kelly and Hackman perhaps

indicators.note: the word is follows, led by the other piece

parts.note: Gene Kelly and Gene Hackman, two actors called Gene

explanation.surface: A musical group fronted by two Hollywood stars.
explanation.definitionFit: Genesis is the British rock group of Peter Gabriel and Phil Collins.

clue.text: Bleeper acts to disguise something that's not so?

definitions.text: Bleeper acts to disguise something that's not so?

indicators.note: disguising the letters rearranges them into a different form

explanation.surface: A broadcast bleep masks a word unfit for polite ears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to disguise' rearranges BLEEPERACTS; the whole clue says a bleep covers a word that is not proper.
explanation.definitionFit: A bleep covers swearing, which is not decent or proper.
